title: SPT-Flow: One Integration, Many Futures in Continuous-Time World Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.41273v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continuous-time world models generate a latent trajectory through a single ODE integration, but adding stochastic conditioning does not ensure that the model uses it. In our teacher-forced baseline, posterior means vary by only about 1% of the prior scale, and matched and swapped latents yield indistinguishable reconstruction PSNR at the reported precision. We study a supervision-shortcut hypothesis: ground-truth intermediate states can reduce the need for trajectory-associated latent information. We introduce SPT-Flow, which samples one latent per trajectory and matches a free-running ODE rollout to demonstration states at multiple readout times. Re-anchoring experiments support the proposed mechanism. translated_title: SPT-Flow：连续时间世界模型中的一次积分，多种未来
translated_abstract: 连续时间世界模型通过单次常微分方程（ODE）积分生成潜在轨迹，但仅仅加入随机条件并不能确保模型真正利用这些条件。在我们的教师强制基线中，后验均值的变化仅约为先验尺度的1%，且匹配与交换后的潜在变量在报告精度下产生难以区分的重建PSNR。我们研究了一种“监督捷径”假说：真实中间状态可能会降低模型对轨迹相关潜在信息的需求。我们提出了SPT-Flow，该方法为每条轨迹仅采样一个潜在变量，并将自由运行的ODE rollout在多个读取时间点上与演示状态进行匹配。重新锚定实验支持了所提出的机制。在LIBERO基准上，当两个模型均训练30k优化器步数时，SPT-Flow相比我们重新训练的ODEWorld基线，在中途帧和最终帧上将best-of-10 PSNR分别提升了2.0和2.4 dB，并将平均LPIPS降低了23%，同时保持可比的性
tldr: 提出SPT-Flow方法，通过为每条轨迹采样单一潜在变量并在多个时间点将自由运行的ODE rollout与演示状态对齐，解决了连续时间世界模型忽视随机条件的问题，在LIBERO上显著提升了视频预测质量（PSNR提升2.0-2.4 dB，LPIPS降低23%）。
en_tdlr: SPT-Flow solves the problem of stochastic conditioning being ignored in continuous-time world models by sampling one latent per trajectory and aligning free-running ODE rollouts with demonstration states at multiple readout times, achieving significant quality improvements on LIBERO (2.0-2.4 dB PSNR gain and 23% LPIPS reduction).
